column3: Storable and Cacheable Content — GET API responses are intentionally cacheable
Server Error Response — ZAP attack payloads legitimately trigger 422/503 responses
XSS Persistent in JSON Response — false positive; API returns application/json only, not executed by browsers; evidence is always empty (Low/Low confidence)
SQL Injection — must never be present
Cross Site Scripting Reflected — must never be present
Server Side Code Injection — must never be present
Path Traversal — must never be present
Remote File Inclusion — must never be present
External Redirect — must never be present

Remote OS Command Injection Time Based — must never be present
